retrieval_task: Given the CASE_001 consultation, identify historical patient records that provide relevant context for reviewing the patient's medical history and medication records. The target is not every record in the patient's chart.
important_status_note: This retrieval gold file is adapted to the reduced P001 dataset ending at encounter ENC_0014. Relevance grades are provisional research annotations and are not clinically validated labels. Verify them against the exact consultation before using this file for final evaluation.

relevance_scale.2: Highly relevant: directly informs medication safety, important comorbidity context, or medication reconciliation.
relevance_scale.1: Relevant: useful historical context but lower priority for this consultation.
relevance_scale.0: Not relevant: should not count as a relevant retrieval target.
relevance_scale.primary_binary_rule: For primary binary precision and recall, relevance grades 1 and 2 count as relevant.

gold_records.relevance_rationale: Important historical cardiovascular condition that provides context when reviewing antihypertensive medication records.
Important chronic condition that provides context for the patient's diabetes-related medication history.

gold_records.source_description: Acute non-ST segment elevation myocardial infarction (disorder)
gold_records.relevance_rationale: Historical cardiovascular event that may help interpret the patient's cardiovascular medication history. It must not be represented as an acute event at the index encounter.
gold_records.description: Acute non-ST segment elevation myocardial infarction (disorder)

gold_records.relevance_rationale: Explicit historical MI entry that provides context for cardiovascular medication records. Related to CON_0011 and should not be double-counted as a separate MI event.
General allergy-related record that provides context for reviewing the patient's allergy history. The specific allergen and reaction should be taken from the corresponding detailed allergy records.
gold_records.retrieval_caution: Do not infer an allergen, reaction, or severity from this general disposition record.

gold_records.relevance_rationale: Provides additional allergy history that may be useful during a medication-safety review, although it is less directly relevant than a medication allergy.
gold_records.retrieval_caution: Do not invent a reaction or severity because neither is recorded.
gold_records.description: Tree pollen (substance); reaction and severity not recorded

gold_records.relevance_rationale: Medication allergy with a recorded severe anaphylactic reaction. Important medication-safety context.
gold_records.retrieval_caution: Preserve cefdinir as the allergen and anaphylaxis as the recorded reaction. Do not infer current exposure.

gold_records.relevance_rationale: Historical medication record that provides context for reviewing the patient's cardiovascular medication history.
gold_records.retrieval_caution: A historical medication entry does not establish current use or adherence.

gold_records.relevance_rationale: Historical cardiovascular medication record that may provide context for the patient's treatment history.
gold_records.retrieval_caution: Do not represent this historical entry as a confirmed current medication.

gold_records.relevance_rationale: Historical lipid-lowering medication record that provides context for reviewing the patient's cardiovascular medication history.
gold_records.retrieval_caution: Do not assume current use based solely on this historical record.

gold_records.relevance_rationale: Historical antihypertensive medication record relevant to understanding the patient's treatment history.
gold_records.retrieval_caution: Do not assume current use or adherence from this historical entry.

gold_records.relevance_rationale: Historical antiplatelet medication record that provides context for reviewing the patient's cardiovascular treatment history.
gold_records.retrieval_caution: Do not infer that the patient is currently taking this medication.

excluded_record_types.current_encounter_observations: Not included in retrieval gold because current encounter measurements should be supplied as common input to all three strategies rather than retrieved as historical context.
excluded_record_types.unrelated_procedures_careplans_devices_i: Excluded unless a reviewer identifies a direct relationship to the consultation's retrieval task.
excluded_record_types.records_after_knowledge_cutoff: Excluded because they occur after the index encounter cutoff.
excluded_record_types.unverified_record_descriptions: Medication records MED_0007 through MED_0014 are not annotated individually here because their complete source descriptions and dates should be verified before assigning relevance grades.

retrieval_scoring.precision: relevant retrieved unique record IDs / all retrieved unique record IDs
retrieval_scoring.recall: relevant retrieved unique record IDs / relevant gold record IDs
retrieval_scoring.f1: 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall), when denominator is nonzero
retrieval_scoring.patient_scope: Only P001 records are eligible. A record belonging to another patient is an error and must not be counted as a relevant retrieval.
retrieval_scoring.cutoff_rule: Exclude records after the knowledge cutoff.
retrieval_scoring.empty_result_rule: If no records are retrieved, precision is undefined by arithmetic; report 0 for the operational summary only if this convention is predeclared. Recall is 0 when relevant gold records exist and none are retrieved.
retrieval_scoring.grading_note: Primary precision and recall use binary relevance (grades 1 and 2). Treat graded ranking metrics such as nDCG as provisional until a ranking protocol is agreed upon.

review_checklist: Verify every record ID and source description against the complete reduced dataset.
Review whether the general allergy disposition ALL_0001 should count independently from the detailed allergy records.
Review whether tree pollen should remain grade 1 for this medication-reconciliation task.
Review whether the five 2009 medication records should count as relevant historical context.
Inspect MED_0007 through MED_0014 and decide whether their medication records should be added to the gold set.
Confirm that the consultation text used in the experiment is consistent with index encounter ENC_0014.
Freeze relevance labels and scoring conventions before final evaluation.
